sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Gopikrishnan Kottoor is an Indian poet whose work also includes drama, translation and literary editing. He founded the poetry journal Poetry Chain and edited A New Book of Poems in English. His contributor note in Shot Glass Journal records appearances in Best Asian Poetry, Acumen and Nth Position.

His collection A Land in the Sun, published by Penprints, offers an entry into a body of work concerned with love, loss, nature and ordinary experience. The publisher highlights poems such as ‘My Father’s Shirt’ and ‘The Last Man in the Bar’. These are starting points in his wider published work; the current Kabita Live catalogue does not yet link a poem to this profile.
